fields.description: What this status means for reporting: open work is Open + Paused, finished work is Resolved + Closed. This is the field every report groups by, so that "open work" never has to be expressed as a hardcoded list of status names — the same role `type` plays on CRM Deal Status. Resolved and Closed are kept apart because Ticket stamps resolution_date off the first and closed_at off the second.
fields.label: Category
